subject: Post-call: Data sharing roadmap & subprocessor rollup for MediSys
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medisyshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Data sharing roadmap & subprocessor rollup for MediSys

Hi Lena / MediSys team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on compliance items that will affect integration timing:

Recap (from our call)
- Use case: clinical triage + secure notes ingestion (PHI).
- Expected monthly throughput: ~12M tokens (burst to 40M).
- Data residency: US-only; MediSys requires customer data to remain in US regions.
- Must have a signed BAA in place before ingesting PHI.

Compliance asks we promised to follow up on
1) SOC 2 Type II report (recent date and any exceptions)
2) BAA template and path to signature
3) Subprocessor inventory (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, support vendors)
4) Data retention and deletion controls (how long KV/prefix cache, logs persist)
5) Encryption and KMS design (who holds keys; bring-your-own-key options)

Immediate next steps
- Can you share the security questionnaire you mentioned? If you prefer, we can start by sending our standard subprocessor CSV and BAA.
- I'll loop in our security lead (Marissa) and SE (Karthik) to prepare a scoped subprocessor list for your review.
- Suggest a follow-up call on Thursday to review any gaps before procurement.

Attachments: I will attach our initial subprocessor inventory and a short mapping doc (stub) for your team to review.

Thanks,
Jonas
---
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

Thanks for the recap, Jonas — good summary.

Quick answers and attachments: we usually run a security questionnaire and ask for a subprocessor roster; happy to accept a CSV for quick review. I attached the MediSys security questionnaire (PDF) for you to fill — it covers SOC, encryption, data flow diagrams, and BAA requirements.

A few clarifications from our legal/privacy team:
- PHI scope: only the minimal clinical notes we send for triage should be considered PHI. No full patient records.
- Residency: must be in US regions, and any cross-region failover needs prior approval.
- SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report (last 12 months) and any open corrective actions.

Attachments: MediSys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf [Attachment: medisys_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Data sharing roadmap & subprocessor rollup for MediSys

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the MediSys questionnaire and their initial asks. Quick asks for our side so I can reply with a targeted package tomorrow: 

1) Marissa — can you pull the most recent SOC 2 Type II (2025 audit) and list any open corrective actions? Also confirm whether our SOC report includes the Dedicated offering / VPC controls (they specifically asked about residency).

2) Karthik — can you generate a concise subprocessor CSV with column headers: vendor_name, service_purpose, data_scope (PHI/PII/none), region, storage_location, contact, and note if a BAA is required? Aim to highlight cloud infra (AWS us-east-1), object storage (S3), monitoring (Datadog), analytics (Segment), support access (PagerDuty / Zendesk), and any third-party model hosting partners.

3) Also: confirm whether we offer BYOK for KMS in Private deployments and the timeline for onboarding if they want keys in a customer-managed KMS.

I'll attach a stub I started: redwood_subprocessors_20260518.csv (stub) and will wait for your updates so I can send a single package back to MediSys.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medisyshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@medisyshealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Data sharing roadmap & subprocessor rollup for MediSys

Jonas / team — thanks for the heads-up. Short answers and next steps from Security: 

- SOC 2: We have a 2025-10 SOC 2 Type II report covering the Hosted API and Dedicated offerings. There is one open corrective action from last cycle (audit evidence linkage for a periodic IAM review) — remediation plan in place; no customer-impacting exceptions. I'll attach the report extract and the remediation note.

- BAA: We have a standard BAA template; Legal prefers to review any redlines but we can share the template immediately.

- Subprocessors: Karthik, thanks for starting the CSV. I've added rows and flagged items that touch PHI. Key items to highlight for MediSys:
  * AWS (us-east-1) — compute + S3 (stores transient cache + logs) — PHI flagged for transient storage; encryption at rest via AWS KMS (customer BYOK supported on Private).
  * CloudBridge (model hosting partner) — hosts model snapshots in US regions; only inference artifacts, no raw PHI persisted.
  * Datadog — monitoring (metrics, no payload-level PHI); logs are scrubbed; retention default 30 days per customer; we can shorten retention on request.
  * Segment — usage analytics (no PHI); used for product telemetry.
  * PagerDuty / Zendesk — support access (support snapshots may include limited request metadata; access is role-based and audited).

- Data retention: KV/prefix cache TTL defaults to 24 hours; full request/response logs retained 90 days in hosted mode; Dedicated/Private can be configured to shorter retention per contract.

Next steps I recommend (to Lena / MediSys):
1) I'll upload the SOC extract and BAA template to the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG).
2) Jonas/Karthik will send the updated subprocessor CSV and a short mapping doc showing where PHI may touch downstream systems.
3) If MediSys needs BYOK, we should scopes out Private deployment timelines — ballpark 6–8 weeks for onboarding and KMS integration.

I'll attach the SOC extract and the BAA template in my follow-up. If useful, we can meet Thursday 5/21 at 10am PT for an hour to walk through the questionnaire and any clarifying controls.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
